Sort by Due Jun 25 11:59pm Available from Jun 21 until Aug 15 10 points possible 1 Reply, 1 Unread 1 Reply, 1 Unread Unsubscribed Manage Discussion Discussion Topic: Lab 1 Discussion - Lab Group 22 Lab 1 Discussion - Lab Group 22 Purpose This discussion is designed to help your group establish clear communication and identify shared availability for working together throughout the term. Use this space to discuss your weekly schedules and determine common times when your group can meet to collaborate and meet with your TA. If scheduling conflicts arise or you have concerns about availability, contact your TA as soon as possible for support. Discussion Instructions To complete your individual discussion post, open the lab handout, then post your answers to Questions Q1–Q4 in your group's discussion thread. Your discussion is meant to initiate the lab exercise and begin the conversation that leads to finding group meeting times. Link to lab handout page: Lab 1 Team Building and Uncertainty Refresher Coordinating With Your Group After completing your post, begin communicating with your group to identify common meeting times. You may use this discussion board, Zoom, Teams, email, or another platform. As a group, you should: confirm that all members have made contact Start by identifying your group members. You can find your assigned group on Canvas under the “People” or “Groups” section. compare weekly availability posted in the Google doc identify at least one shared time for group collaboration identify possible times to meet with your TA and secure a time slot in their schedule in the Course Information module If your group cannot find overlapping availability, notify your lead TA so they can help resolve scheduling issues. During this first week, anyone available early in the week is encouraged to take initiative in starting communication. Collaboration and professional communication are shared responsibilities.
